_comment: Voice casting for tools/voices.mjs. `want` describes the ideal voice. `node tools/voices.mjs --audition` searches the ElevenLabs Voice Library with each role's `search` terms and builds tools/audition.html to listen to the options; `--cast pip=2,thorin=1` adds your picks to your account and updates the ids here. `settings` is sent as voice_settings (speed: 0.7-1.2).

narrator.name: George
narrator.want: Warm, theatrical British storyteller. The dungeon master, relishing every twist.

pip.name: Callum
pip.want: Jittery, fast-talking halfling innkeeper. Lighter, higher male voice, always on the edge of panic.

thorin.name: Harry
thorin.want: Gruff, gravelly old dwarf warrior. Deep, proud, wounded.

halden.name: Bill
halden.want: Middle-aged priest, deep and solemn, but tipsy and shaken tonight.

seraphine.name: Lily
seraphine.want: Sultry, amused, dangerous merchant. Purring and unbothered.

lyra.name: Alice
lyra.want: Elven bard. Soft, musical and warm on the surface, cold steel underneath.
